messages:
Sasha (Design): Quick design question — empty state for Private deployments onboarding. Screenshot: https://figma.redwood/example
Current copy in the mock: "No private deployments yet. Create one to run Redwood in your network." Thoughts?

Priya (Eng): Slight nit — "run Redwood" feels vague. Might be better to call out VPC/on-prem specifically: "Deploy Redwood Private in your VPC or on-prem." Also we should avoid implying we auto-create infra.

Ethan (PM): +1 on avoiding implied provisioning. From a product POV, lead with the value (data stays in your network, control, audit logs). Short headline, value sentence, then CTA + learn link. CTA wording: "Get started" vs "Create private deployment" — leaning toward friendlier "Get started".

Nora (Docs): Accessibility nits: keep sentences short, avoid passive voice. For the learn link, use explicit link text like "Learn how Private works" not just "Learn more". Also include an aria-friendly description for the CTA.

Sasha (Design): Nice — throwing some microcopy options here. Feedback on tone + CTA?

Option A (concise):
Headline: "No private deployments"
Body: "Keep data and inference inside your network. Deploy Redwood Private to a VPC or on-premise."
Primary CTA: "Get started"
Secondary: "Learn how Private works"

Option B (friendly + low-commit):
Headline: "Ready to run Redwood privately?"
Body: "Keep data local and control access — no changes until you finish setup."
Primary CTA: "Start setup"
Secondary: "See deployment options"

Option C (technical for admins):
Headline: "Deploy Redwood Private"
Body: "Provision a VPC or on-prem host and connect with KMS, audit logs, and network policies."
Primary CTA: "Create deployment"
Secondary: "Deployment docs (admins)"

Priya (Eng): I prefer B for onboarding — "Start setup" clarifies it isn't instant. For C, maybe keep behind an admin toggle in the flow. Also suggest the small caption: "No charges until you provision compute."

Ethan (PM): B +1. Tiny wording tweak on body: "Keep data local and control access — you won’t be charged until you provision resources." That removes the word "finish" which sounds vague.

Nora (Docs): For the learn link text in B, maybe: "See deployment options and prerequisites" — more discoverable. Also, aria label suggestion for primary CTA: "Start private deployment setup (opens setup wizard)".

Sasha (Design): Updated mock with Variant B + your tweaks. New copy in figma: "Ready to run Redwood privately?" / "Keep data local and control access — you won’t be charged until you provision resources." / Primary CTA: "Start setup" / Secondary: "See deployment options and prerequisites". Linked here: https://figma.redwood/example2

Priya (Eng): That reads well. Also can we add a tiny inline helper under CTA (light text): "Admin permissions required" with a tooltip explaining roles.

Ethan (PM): Cool — add the helper. Once Nora gives final phrasing for the tooltip, let's ship this to docs for final pass.

Nora (Docs): Will do a final pass on the tooltip and microcopy. Suggest tooltip copy: "Requires organization admin or infra role to provision network resources. See roles docs."

DevOps Bot: Figma updated: https://figma.redwood/example2 — version 3. Notes: variant B selected, CTA changed to "Start setup", added helper text.

Sasha (Design): Great — locking in Variant B with the helper and doc link. I'll update the figma comments and ping docs for final copy polish. :thumbsup:
